pivHint: I THANK my God every time I remember you, Paul writes. Before a meal, some families pause to say a prayer of thanks known as ______.
winText: You found it. THANK isn't just what Paul does for the Philippians — before a meal, a short prayer of thanks is often called saying GRACE.
lossText: The word was GRACE. THANK was the pivot — before eating, many families say a short prayer of thanks known as GRACE. GRACE is also the theological term for God's undeserved favor.
votdVerse: I thank my God every time I remember you.
passageText: I thank my God every time I remember you. In all my prayers for all of you, I always pray with joy because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now, being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
